exposure: Retained products of conception (RPOC) following cesarean delivery
outcome: Incidence of RPOC following cesarean delivery
cohort: 24 women who underwent hysteroscopy for treatment of suspected RPOC following cesarean delivery
finding: RPOC following cesarean delivery is rare (0.21% incidence in this study) but treatable with hysteroscopy, which has low complication and postoperative intrauterine adhesion rates.
